scripts.clean: find . -type d \( -name node_modules -o -name dist -o -name .tanstack -o -name .wrangler -o -name .output -o -name .vinxi \) -prune -exec rm -rf {} + && find . -type f -name '*.tsbuildinfo' -delete
scripts.reauth: npx wrangler logout && npx wrangler login
scripts.build: pnpm -r run build && pnpm --filter "./apps/*" run build:stage
scripts.deploy-admin-application:stage: pnpm install --filter admin-application... && pnpm --filter admin-application run deploy:stage
scripts.deploy-shelter-application:stage: pnpm install --filter shelter-application... && pnpm --filter shelter-application run deploy:stage
scripts.deploy-user-application:stage: pnpm install --filter user-application... && pnpm --filter user-application run deploy:stage
scripts.deploy-api-service:stage: pnpm install --filter api-service... && pnpm --filter api-service run deploy:stage
scripts.deploy-admin-application:prod: pnpm install --filter admin-application... && pnpm --filter admin-application run deploy:prod
scripts.deploy-shelter-application:prod: pnpm install --filter shelter-application... && pnpm --filter shelter-application run deploy:prod
scripts.deploy-user-application:prod: pnpm install --filter user-application... && pnpm --filter user-application run deploy:prod
scripts.deploy-api-service:prod: pnpm install --filter api-service... && pnpm --filter api-service run deploy:prod
